Definition & Business Rules: Unique identifier for each applicant (e.g., UUID or AP-10001).
Self-reported or verified gross annual income from tax documents in USD.
Length of time with current employer in months.
Baseline credit score (FICO/VantageScore) at profile creation.
Internal risk classification. Values: Excellent, Good, Fair, Subprime.
Geographic location/market territory. Values: Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, Southwest, West.
Date of birth. Validation: Current Date - birth_date >= 18.
Legal classification of work relationship. Values: employed, self-employed, retired.
Legal nature of residential situation. Values: Rent, own, other.
Applicant's state abbreviation (e.g., 'NC').
Time and date the application was submitted.
Unique identifier for each individual transaction event (e.g., EV-10001).
Links back to applicants.applicant_id.
Product Code for the loan the applicant is applying for.
Timestamp of when the credit pull was executed.
Debt to income ratio at time of credit pull.
Score returned by bureau. Validation: Must be between 300 and 850. Can be null if pull failed.
System-calculated tier change. Values: No_Change, Upgraded, Downgraded, Not_Applicable. Rule: Use Not_Applicable if first pull or if pull failed.
Credit bureau requested. Values: EQUIFAX, EXPERIAN, TRANSUNION.
Operational result. Values: SUCCESS, FAILED, PENDING.
Reason for pull failure. Rule: Must be NULL if pull_status is SUCCESS. Values: RATE_LIMITED, PROVIDER_ERROR, TIMEOUT, INVALID_REQUEST.
Unique tracking string returned by the provider. Used to catch duplicate responses.
Credit-tier rules used to classify risk. Values:Low Risk, Moderate Risk, High Risk, Very High Risk, Review.
Short identifying code. Values: MNT-01 (Term/Installment), REV-02 (Revolving).
Plain text mapping score brackets to Low, Moderate, High, or Very High Risk tiers.(see below).*
Baseline annual percentage rate (APR) before adjustments (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%).
Hard cap on the principal amount that can be issued.
Descriptive name of the credit product.
Minimum repayment length. Values: 24, 36, 48, 60, 72.
Maximum repayment length. Values: 24, 36, 48, 60, 72.
Maximum permitted debt-to-income ratio represented as a percentage (e.g., 36.50 = 36.5%).
Unique identifier for each loan application record.
References applicant_id in applicants.csv to identify the borrowing entity.
References product_code in loan_products.csv to map terms, base rate, and eligibility rules.
The timestamp indicating when the loan application was finalized.
Status of the application: Approved, Denied, Under Review.
The final loan amount approved for the applicant (0 if denied).
The approved duration/payback term of the loan (in number of months).
Foreign key referencing the underwriting policy documentation governing the decision.
Foreign key referencing the underwriting policy documentation governing the decision.
Logs the specific underwriting or eligibility rule ID that triggered the decision status.
